title: Surface place + billable client in review and export
userStory: As a user I can see and export the place and billable client for each receipt.
acceptanceCriteria: buildReceiptSheet gains always-present columns location and billable_client (blank string when no context), read from receipt.context.*; buildCsv updated to emit them. The existing golden-CSV assert.deepEqual in scripts/verify-acceptance.js is UPDATED to the new fixed schema (header + rows) - clean row = trailing empty cells; enriched row = place + client populated. Duplicate/needs-review behavior unchanged.
Review screen shows the captured place and matched billable client with a confirm/clear toggle; wiring extracted into a testable helper App.js calls.
npm test passes: new-schema CSV assertions (clean + enriched rows); App.js source asserts the place + billable UI renders.
